anchors = genetics.sql("""

WHERE symbol IN ('DGCR6','PRODH','TBX1','COMT','USP18','ZNF74','KLHL22','MED15','PI4KA','CRKL','LZTR1','HIC2','TOP3B')

                    ('A-B (~1.5 Mb proximal nested deletion, chr22:18.9-20.3 Mb)', 18900000, 20300000)]:
    df = genetics.sql(f"""

    WHERE chr = 22 AND gene_start >= {s} AND gene_end <= {e}
